description: No policies and procedures to safeguard the facility and equipment from unauthorized physical access, tampering, and theft.
applicability: This signal applies to: Healthcare facilities and data centers Server rooms and network closets Workstations and portable devices accessing ePHI Storage media containing ePHI Physical access control systems

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Examine facility security documentation for comprehensive policies addressing physical access controls, anti-tampering measures, and theft prevention. Review physical security assessments, perimeter security controls, surveillance systems, and alarm systems. Verify that procedures address all areas where ePHI is accessed, stored, or transmitted.
